series.name: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)
series.notes: E-family faults/status from PK cross-checked tables + greecomfort official article subset.

title.ur: Water pump ki hifazat ka trip

meaning.en: The unit locked out the water pump circuit used for drainage/dehumidification after detecting a pump or level-switch fault.
meaning.ur: Unit ne dehumidification aur pani nikalne wale circuit ko pump ya level switch ki kharabi ki wajah se band kar diya.

causes.en: Water pump motor failed or seized
causes.ur: Water pump motor band ho gaya ya jam gaya

causes.en: Liquid level switch open/short or abnormal resistance
causes.ur: Liquid level switch open/short ho gaya ya resistance gair-mamooli hai

causes.en: Loose or broken pump wiring / blocked inlet-outlet
causes.ur: Pump ki wiring dhili ya tooti hui hai, inlet-outlet band hai

solutions.en: Clean water inlet/outlet paths and clear the drain
solutions.ur: Pehle water inlet/outlet ke raaste saaf karein aur drain khali karein

solutions.en: Test and replace level-switch wiring or the switch itself
solutions.ur: Level switch ki wiring check karein, kharab ho to switch ya wiring badlein

solutions.en: Replace the pump; if fault persists, service controller main board
solutions.ur: Pump badlein; masla phir bhi rahe to controller main board service karein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Quarantined variant: airconditioningmanuals states E0 = insufficient start voltage (RU-derived). Most PK sources = water pump. Per-code attribution: acguide.pk.
notes.ur: Quarantined variant: airconditioningmanuals ke mutabiq E0 = kam start voltage (RU se aayi). Zyada tar PK sources mein yeh water pump hai. Per-code attribution: acguide.pk.

meaning.en: Discharge/high pressure exceeded the safe limit; system shut down to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: Discharge/high pressure had se zyada hone ki wajah se system band ho gaya taake compressor ko hifazat mil sake.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor condenser or blocked airflow
causes.ur: Bahar ka condenser ganda hai ya airflow band hai

causes.en: Refrigerant overcharge or non-condensables
causes.ur: Refrigerant zyada bhar gaya ya us mein non-condensable gas hai

causes.en: Failed outdoor fan or stuck expansion device
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kharab hai ya expansion device atka hua hai

causes.en: Faulty high-pressure sensor/switch wiring
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor/switch ki wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean condenser coils and filters; ensure 2–3 ft clearance around outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Condenser coils aur filters saaf karein; outdoor unit ke gird 2-3 foot ki jagah khuli rakhein

solutions.en: Have a technician verify charge and pressure-switch operation
solutions.ur: Technician se charge aur pressure-switch ka kaam verify karwayein

solutions.en: Replace fan motor, expansion valve, or pressure sensor as diagnosed
solutions.ur: Jaise diagnose ho, fan motor, expansion valve ya pressure sensor badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: 2+ PK sources + official greecomfort article agree. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.
notes.ur: 2+ PK sources aur official greecomfort article agree karte hain. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

codes.blinkPattern: Running lamp family; blink count = N for code EN (general rule, count model-dependent)

meaning.en: Evaporator temperature dropped below the freeze threshold in cool/dry mode; compressor and condenser fan paused.
meaning.ur: Cooling/dry mode mein evaporator ka temperature jam ki had se neeche gir gaya; compressor aur condenser fan ruk gaye.

causes.en: Clogged air filter or blocked return/supply grilles
causes.ur: Air filter ganda hai ya return/supply grilles band hain

causes.en: Low refrigerant or restricted airflow
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hai ya airflow roka hua hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor temperature sensor
causes.ur: Indoor ka temperature sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Dirty evaporator coil
causes.ur: Evaporator coil gandi hai

solutions.en: Clean/replace filters and clear vents; allow ice to melt 2–3 hours
solutions.ur: Filters saaf ya badlein aur vents khali karein; barf ko 2-3 ghante mein pigalne dein

solutions.en: Restart; if code returns, check for leaks and sensor failure (technician)
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; code wapas aaye to technician se leak aur sensor check karwayein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Protection may be normal self-clear behavior in mild cases. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official-adjacent.
notes.ur: Halki halat mein yeh protection apne aap theek bhi ho sakti hai (self-clear). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official-adjacent.

meaning.en: System pressure fell too low — often leak, low charge, or restricted suction side.
meaning.ur: System ka pressure bohat kam ho gaya — aam taur par refrigerant ki leak, kam charge ya suction side ka band hona.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak / undercharge
causes.ur: Refrigerant leak hai ya gas kam hai

causes.en: Dirty filter, fan, or evaporator
causes.ur: Filter, fan ya evaporator ganda hai

causes.en: Faulty low-pressure switch
causes.ur: Low-pressure switch kharab hai

causes.en: Can appear transiently during refrigerant-recovery mode (not always a fault)
causes.ur: Refrigerant-recovery mode mein waqti tor par bhi aa sakta hai (hamesha fault nahi)

solutions.en: Clean filter/fan/evaporator and outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Pehle filter, fan, evaporator aur outdoor fan saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician: leak search, repair, vacuum, and weighed recharge
solutions.ur: Technician leak dhoondein, repair karein, vacuum karein aur taul kar gas bharein

solutions.en: Check low-pressure switch and wiring
solutions.ur: Low-pressure switch aur uski wiring check karein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

title.ur: Compressor discharge high temperature ki hifazat

meaning.en: Discharge gas temperature exceeded the protective limit (sources cite ~115 °C check point); after repeated trips the unit latches off until power cycle.
meaning.ur: Discharge gas ka temperature hifazati had se zyada ho gaya (manzil ~115 °C check point batati hain); baar baar trip hone par unit lock ho kar band ho jata hai aur power cycle ke baghair dobara nahi chalta.

causes.en: Low refrigerant or restricted flow
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hai ya flow roka hua hai

causes.en: Dirty condenser / poor ventilation
causes.ur: Condenser ganda hai / ventilation theek nahi

causes.en: Faulty discharge sensor or compressor
causes.ur: Discharge sensor ya compressor kharab hai

causes.en: Reversing/mode issues in heat pump variants
causes.ur: Heat pump versions mein reversing/mode ka masla hai

solutions.en: Power off, clean outdoor unit, wait ~30 min, restart
solutions.ur: Power band karein, outdoor unit saaf karein, taqreeban 30 minute intezaar karein, phir start karein

solutions.en: Technician: verify sensor reading <115 °C, leak test, repair, recharge
solutions.ur: Technician sensor ki reading 115 degree C se kam verify kare, leak test kare, repair kare, phir gas bhare

solutions.en: Replace sensor or main board only after electrical checks
solutions.ur: Sirf electrical checks ke baad hi sensor ya main board badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Electrafix blog loosely called E4 “voltage”; primary meaning = discharge temp (majority). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + electrafix + maqsood.
notes.ur: Electrafix blog ne E4 ko loosely voltage kaha hai; asal meaning discharge temp hai (majority). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + electrafix + maqsood.

meaning.en: Line voltage too high, too low/unstable, or measured current exceeded the trip threshold; outdoor unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Line voltage bohat zyada, bohat kam ya be-qarar hone par, ya measured current trip threshold se zyada hone par outdoor unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Unstable mains or wrong-rated supply
causes.ur: Mains unstable hain ya supply ka rating ghalat hai

causes.en: Wiring/contactor faults
causes.ur: Wiring ya contactor mein kharabi hai

causes.en: Compressor electrical fault drawing excess current
causes.ur: Compressor ki electrical kharabi se current zyada lag raha hai

solutions.en: Verify dedicated circuit and stabilizer output; fix supply
solutions.ur: Pehle dedicated circuit aur stabilizer ka output verify karein, supply theek karwayein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect compressor windings, overcurrent sensor, board
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki windings, overcurrent sensor aur board check kare

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Official greecomfort: “overcurrent protection… high line voltage or unstable low supply.” Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.
notes.ur: Official greecomfort ke mutabiq: overcurrent protection, high line voltage ya unstable low supply. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan communication kharab

meaning.en: The data link between indoor and outdoor control boards dropped or became unreadable; cooling/heating stops until link restored.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor board ke darmiyan data link toot gaya ya parhaya nahi ja raha; link theek hone tak cooling/heating band rahti hai.

causes.en: Loose, corroded, damaged, or miswired interconnect cable (most common after install/service)
causes.ur: Interconnect cable dhili, zang aayi, tooti ya ghalat lagi hui (install/service ke baad sabse zyada)

causes.en: Outdoor unit unpowered while indoor powered
causes.ur: Indoor chal raha ho aur outdoor unit ko power na ho

causes.en: PCB transmit/receive fault on either board
causes.ur: Kisi bhi board par PCB transmit/receive kharab hai

causes.en: Communication wires routed near high-voltage lines (interference)
causes.ur: Communication wires high-voltage lines ke bohot paas se gayi hain (interference)

solutions.en: Power both units off at breaker ~1 minute and restart together
solutions.ur: Breaker se dono units ka power taqreeban 1 minute band karein aur saath mein start karein

solutions.en: Confirm outdoor disconnect/breaker is on
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke outdoor disconnect/breaker on hai

solutions.en: Technician: inspect interconnect wiring and test both control boards
solutions.ur: Technician interconnect wiring check kare aur dono control boards test kare

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Very common inverter fault in PK service calls. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official + heatpumpanswers.
notes.ur: PK service calls mein yeh bohot common inverter fault hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official + heatpumpanswers.

codes.blinkPattern: Running lamp blinks for E-family (incl. E6) per airconditioningmanuals

meaning.en: Indoor and outdoor units disagree on operating mode (e.g., one in heat, one in cool), common on multi-split systems.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke operating mode aapas mein match nahi karte (misal ke tor par ek heat mein aur doosra cool mein); aam tor par yeh multi-split systems mein hota hai.

causes.en: Configuration/setting mismatch after power event
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad configuration/setting ka farq ho gaya

causes.en: Flow-switch or pump issue cited by some service notes
causes.ur: Kuch service notes mein flow-switch ya pump ka masla bataya gaya hai

causes.en: Loose control wiring
causes.ur: Control wiring dhili hai

solutions.en: Set both units to the same mode and power-cycle
solutions.ur: Dono units ko ek hi mode mein set karein aur power cycle karein

solutions.en: Check flow switch/pump on hydronic variants; fix wiring
solutions.ur: Hydronic versions mein flow switch/pump check karein; wiring theek karein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Official: often homeowner-fixable. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.
notes.ur: Official ke mutabiq: aksar ghar ka banda khud theek kar sakta hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

title.ur: Indoor fan ya high temperature ki hifazat (model ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: Depending on series: indoor fan motor or indoor circuit problem, or anti-high-temperature lockout.
meaning.ur: Series ke mutabiq: indoor fan motor ya indoor circuit ki kharabi, ya anti-high-temperature lockout.

causes.en: Faulty indoor fan motor or loose motor wiring
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kharab hai ya motor ki wiring dhili hai

causes.en: Indoor main PCB fault
causes.ur: Indoor main PCB kharab hai

causes.en: Restricted airflow / high ambient causing thermal trip
causes.ur: Airflow band ya zyada ambient temperature ki wajah se thermal trip

solutions.en: Check and reseat indoor fan wiring; replace motor if dead
solutions.ur: Indoor fan ki wiring check karke theek se lagayein; motor dead ho to badlein

solutions.en: Improve ventilation and clean filters; restart after cooldown
solutions.ur: Ventilation behtar karein aur filters saaf karein; thanda hone par restart karein

solutions.en: Technician: replace indoor board if motor tests good
solutions.ur: Technician motor theek test ho to indoor board badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Conflicting meanings across sources (fan vs anti-high-temp) — model check required. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (meanings diverge).
notes.ur: Sources ke darmiyan meaning ka conflict hai (fan vs anti-high-temp) — model check zaroori hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (meanings diverge).

meaning.en: Water flow switch or condensate/drain condition fault; after repeated trips (e.g., 3×/60 min) manual power reset required.
meaning.ur: Water flow switch ya condensate/drain ki kharabi; baar baar trip hone par (misal ke tor par 60 minute mein 3 baar) power kat kar dobara on karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Blocked drain pipe / full tray
causes.ur: Drain pipe band hai / tray bhar gayi hai

causes.en: Failed drain or condensate pump
causes.ur: Drain ya condensate pump kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty water flow switch or wiring
causes.ur: Water flow switch ya uski wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Clear drain line and tray; level the unit
solutions.ur: Drain line aur tray khali karein; unit ko level karein

solutions.en: Test/replace pump and flow switch; board last resort
solutions.ur: Pump aur flow switch test karein ya badlein; board ka masla sirf tab dekhein jab doosra ilaaj kaam na aaye.

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Floor-standing / pumped-drain models more common. Per-code attribution: multi-pk.
notes.ur: Yeh zyada tar floor-standing aur pumped-drain models mein hota hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk.

meaning.en: Control board failed to read/write stored configuration data in EEPROM.
meaning.ur: Control board EEPROM mein store ki gayi configuration data read/write nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Corrupted EEPROM contents
causes.ur: EEPROM ka data kharab (corrupt) ho gaya hai

causes.en: Failing memory chip on outdoor (or drive) board
causes.ur: Outdoor (ya drive) board par memory chip fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Disconnect mains power for 2 minutes, then switch on again so the board re-reads the stored EEPROM configuration
solutions.ur: Mains power 2 minute ke liye band karein, phir on karein taake board EEPROM mein store configuration dobara read kare

solutions.en: If the code returns, a technician reads the EEPROM on the outdoor/drive board, reprograms the data, or replaces the memory chip
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician outdoor/drive board ka EEPROM parhe, data reprogram kare ya memory chip badle

source.title: Cross-checked: acguide.pk + aysonline.pk + japanelectronics.pk + electrafix.pk + greecomfort.com official article + heatpumpanswers.com

notes.en: Lowercase `ee` sometimes = drive-board memory vs `EE` outdoor main PCB (aliases cover both). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.
notes.ur: Chhota ee kabhi kabhi drive-board memory hai, aur EE outdoor main PCB (dono ke liye aliases maujood hain). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.

title.ur: IPM over temperature (frequency kam ho gayi)

meaning.en: Intelligent power module is too hot; drive lowers operating frequency to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Intelligent power module bohat garm ho gaya; khud ko hifazat dene ke liye drive operating frequency kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: Poor outdoor ventilation or dirty heat exchanger
causes.ur: Outdoor ki ventilation kamzor hai ya heat exchanger ganda hai

causes.en: Overloaded or failing IPM
causes.ur: IPM par load zyada hai ya woh fail ho raha hai

causes.en: Weak thermal paste / loose IPM screws (service-level)
causes.ur: Thermal paste kamzor hai / IPM ke screws dhile hain (service level)

solutions.en: Clear outdoor airflow and clean coils; restart after cool-down
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki airflow khuli rakhein aur coils saaf karein; thanda hone ke baad restart karein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect IPM, thermal interface, drive board
solutions.ur: Technician IPM, thermal interface aur drive board check kare
